page.overview:
What is CP0?

CP0, more properly known as , is the strongest intelligence agency among Cipher Pol, working directly under the World Nobles. They first appeared on the northeast of Dressrosa near Cafe Bar La Baltad.

Due to their actions and role, they are major antagonists during the Levely Arc, the secondary antagonist group of the Wano Country Arc and Egghead Arc, and one of the central antagonist groups throughout the second half of the series.

CP0 is the strongest of all Cipher Pol units, even surpassing the assassination specialists of CP9. It is said that when CP0 is active, world-shaking events are about to occur. Much is unknown about the agents and their abilities; however, the agents of this group are shown to be masters of the Six Powers and are proficient in Haki, as Lucci, Kaku, Stussy, Guernika, Blueno, Kalifa, Jabra, Kumadori, and Fukurou all know Armament and Observation Haki. The agents who wear masks are among the most elite fighters of CP0, stated to be in a class of their own. They are collectively known as the . A masked member of CP0 is easily capable of defeating even an artificial Ancient Giant. Their strength, though inferior to an Emperor, is close enough to that of an Emperor's high-ranking officer, with agents defeating the likes of X Drake (one of the Worst Generation and former Tobiroppo of the Beasts Pirates), battling Izou (a former Division Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates) to a draw, and battling Roronoa Zoro (one of the Worst Generation and a Senior Officer in the Straw Hat Pirates) for a considerable amount of time.

CP0 agents work directly under the command of the World Nobles. They have strong intel over a myriad of subjects concerning the World Government, including the Artificial Devil Fruit Vegapunk created with Kaidou's Lineage Factor and X Drake's true allegiance. However, despite being the highest-ranking Cipher Pol unit, they do not have the authority to engage in a fight against one of the Four Emperors without being ordered to, leading to them requiring to contact the Marines.
